group_position: first shot of grp002 — both girls at blocking_map start (sitting_shelf); neither has a path, so they hold this ground for the whole group.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: on the grass a body's width downhill (south) of her sister at sitting_shelf
characters.space_fragment_en: lying face down on the grass at the sister's sitting place, a body's width downhill on screen-left, facing the still backwater
characters.facing: body along the slope, chin on her fists, eyes out over the water; her sister is at her screen-right shoulder

beats.action: shifts her weight from one elbow to the other
plucks at a grass stem and lets it go

performance_beat.objective: find something — anything — in this afternoon worth looking at
performance_beat.goal: find something worth looking at in a hot empty afternoon
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from flat boredom to boredom with an edge of restlessness
performance_beat.arc_to: restlessness beginning to show in the hands

trigger.beat: she plucks the grass stem and lets it fall

performance_beat.end_state: chin still on her fists, eyes flat on the water, one hand picking slowly at the turf

characters.label: Alice's Sister
characters.start_pos: upright on the flat shelf under the northern elm at sitting_shelf
characters.space_fragment_en: sitting upright at the sister's sitting place under the northern elm, just screen-right of centre, facing down into the open book
characters.facing: square to the backwater, head bowed, eyes on the print; she never lifts them

beats.action: turns a page with one finger
beats.sync: the only movement in her half of the frame

performance_beat.objective: stay inside the book and let the afternoon look after itself
performance_beat.emotional_arc: from absorbed to absorbed — she is the fixed point of the scene
performance_beat.end_state: head bowed over the page, eyes on the print, thumb flat at the margin, no movement in the shoulders

presence_check.story_event: ev0001 (real_frame, T0) — the bank beside her sister, a hot summer afternoon
presence_check.note: Alice and her sister are the only two legal presences on the bank. CRE-001 has not broken cover yet; CHAR-white-rabbit belongs to the dream layer and can never appear in the real frame (shot_list entity_note; realistic_adaptation_flags rn-02).
